lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in at least four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits and dorsal to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the centroids of the circular blobs, creating a grid-like appearance on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper flank, each displaying a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small fish, characteristic of a remora, attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
